diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all rollouts despite A3 not having PF2, because the model defaulted to a purchase and enabled the accelerated depreciation election, which aligns with the default settings in the scenario. This indicates a structural leak where the model uses default values that bypass the need for PF2.

C5.why: Without PF2, the purchase-versus-lease choice and accelerated-depreciation election have no identified tax basis; PF2 changes the required funding choice to purchase and turns the election on.
